reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes entering Forsage through a direct-message registration route, starting with 0.05 ETH and purchasing progressively more expensive slots. Its diagrams associate those purchases with twice the prior income, and its description frames participation around earning and withdrawing money.

citations.quote: Crypto Currency Ethereum Forsage Smart Contract for registration DM [PHONE](4)
When you register in Forsage with 0.05 ETH you open both programs simultaneously
Each subsequent slot you purchase is two times the value of the previous one and it generates twice the income as well
In each of these two programs Forsage x3 and Forsage x4 there are twelve slots
You'll definitely need to fill in the blank in order to earn

opening.argument: The material does not document a completed payout or a guaranteed personal result. Its description presents the subject through questions: “What is FORESAGE?”, “How can I earn from FORSAGE?”, and “When can I withdraw my money from FORSAGE?” [citation]. The narration explains that registering with 0.05 ETH opens two programs, but that describes an entry condition rather than proving that anyone earned or withdrew money [citation]. The presentation therefore leaves the practical outcome uncertain and can be read as informational rather than as a deceptive guarantee.

citations.quote: What is FORESAGE?* *How can I earn from FORSAGE?* *When can I withdraw my money from FORSAGE?
When you register in Forsage with 0.05 ETH you open both programs simultaneously

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats the registration contact and the 0.05 ETH entry point as proof of a scam, but the title only identifies a registration route, while the narration only explains what registration opens. Its “twice the value” statement is a description of the stated slot progression, not evidence that a viewer actually received money. The cited material does not establish a completed transaction, payout, or guaranteed outcome.

citations.quote: Crypto Currency Ethereum Forsage Smart Contract for registration DM [PHONE](4)
Each subsequent slot you purchase is two times the value of the previous one and it generates twice the income as well

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The questions are not warnings or uncertainty about whether the system is safe; they specifically foreground earning and withdrawal. The narration then connects registration to opening programs and says later purchases generate twice the income. The defense is correct that no completed payout is shown, but deceptive promotion does not require proof that a payout already occurred. These quotes fail to show neutral risk disclosure or criticism.

citations.quote: How can I earn from FORSAGE?
When can I withdraw my money from FORSAGE?
it generates twice the income as well

opening.argument: The video can reasonably be understood as an explanation of how Forsage is structured. The narration explicitly introduces the x4 layout, describes the positions in its first and second lines, identifies the x3 and x4 programs, and says examples will follow [citation]. The sampled frames likewise present labeled x3 and x4 diagrams with numbered slots and displayed values [citation]. That is consistent with an operational demonstration of a program’s structure; the supplied material does not show a personal testimonial, a completed result, or a direct verbal command to participate.

citations.quote: places in one line in The Forsage x4 Program below you are two lines two places in the first line and four places in the second line
In each of these two programs Forsage x3 and Forsage x4 there are twelve slots
I will give you several examples.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution interprets every diagram as an inducement, but diagrams can explain a system without establishing that the presenter is certifying it or reporting a successful result. The narration says it will provide examples and explains the slot arrangement; it does not state that the speaker personally earned money. Even the income language describes the program’s stated progression, not a verified outcome.

citations.quote: And to get this perfect picture I will give you several examples.
Each subsequent slot you purchase is two times the value of the previous one and it generates twice the income as well

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The diagrams are not merely abstract technical instruction: they show branching participant positions, numbered slots, and escalating amounts alongside the explanation that later slots generate twice the income. The phrase “you’ll definitely need to fill in the blank in order to earn” gives the explanation an earning-oriented purpose. The defense correctly notes that no personal payout is shown, but that does not remove the promotional recruitment mechanism depicted and described.

citations.quote: You'll definitely need to fill in the blank in order to earn
Each subsequent slot you purchase is two times the value of the previous one and it generates twice the income as well

opening.argument: The evidence is compatible with promotion of access to an external digital program rather than proof of a scam transaction. The title calls it a “Smart Contract” and supplies a registration contact, while the description asks what Forsage is and how withdrawal works [citation]. Crucially, the supplied material does not show a viewer sending funds, surrendering credentials, receiving a payout, or being promised a particular return. The frames show diagrams and values, but a diagram alone does not establish that the displayed amounts were paid or that recruitment was completed [citation].

citations.quote: Crypto Currency Ethereum Forsage Smart Contract for registration DM [PHONE](4)
What is FORESAGE?* *How can I earn from FORSAGE?* *When can I withdraw my money from FORSAGE?

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution infers a tiered scam from the presence of slots and increasing values, but those features alone do not prove that money changed hands or that a downline payout occurred. The title’s contact information establishes a way to register, not what the contact would request or whether anyone used it. The evidence therefore supports, at most, an explanation or promotion of an external program whose safety and outcomes remain unverified.

citations.quote: for registration DM [PHONE](4)
In each of these two programs Forsage x3 and Forsage x4 there are twelve slots

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The mechanism is more specific than ordinary commerce: registration opens two programs, each contains twelve slots, and subsequent purchased slots are said to double both value and income. The frames show branching participant structures and escalating displayed amounts, while the title provides a direct registration route. The defense is right that no completed transaction is shown, but the absence of a completed payout does not negate the solicitation mechanism itself.
